characters.name: Kimberly Ann "Kim" Parker
characters.description: Nikki's daughterand the Professor's eventual stepdaughter. Big Beautiful Woman: She's chubby, but very confident and fashionable. Book Dumb: She gets horrible grades anddoesn't graduate community college. Bratty Teenage Daughter: In earlier episodes, she matures a bit in later episodes Catchphrase: Heyyy and Dang, Mamma!

characters.name: Nikki Parker
characters.description: Kim's motherand the Professor's eventual wife. Big Beautiful Woman: She's quite a thick-set woman, but she surely knows how to dress and is quite easy on the eyes. Big Fun: She's a large woman and she's quite jovial. Book Smart: In contrast to her daughter, and the despite the fact that she had toput her education on hold to take care of her daughter Kim, Nikki is shown to be a really good student in community college. Catchphrase: "Heyyy~!"

characters.name: Stevie Alison Van Lowe
characters.description: Kim's best friendand eventual business partner. Lonely Rich Kid: Growing up, she never got much attention from her parents, especially not her mother. Only Sane Man: Stevie tends to be the most sane and down-to-earth among the cast, often acting as the voice of reason. Ship Tease: She getsplentyof this with T over the course of the series. Spoiled Sweet: Downplayed as she's notsupersweet, but despite coming from an affluent family, she doesn't display anyRich Bitchtendencies and is quite sociable.

characters.name: Thaddeus "T" Radcliffe
characters.description: A music student and friend of Kim and Stevie.

characters.name: Andell Wilkerson
characters.description: Nikki's best friend and the owner of The Den and, later, Andell's.

characters.name: Professor Stanley De'Vanté Oglevee
characters.description: A professor at Santa Monica College and Nikki's crushand eventual husband. Only Sane Man: Sometimes fills this role (mainly in the first season), but more often than not subverts this trope by showing himself capable of being almost as chaotic as Nikki and Kim if pushed far enough. By the final season, there are several episodes where he engages in shenanigans on his own without Nikki ever being involved.
